title: Pink Hammer Girl
description: Two posed views of a confident female character with bright pink hair in a high ponytail, wearing a pink and black outfit with thigh-high stockings and boots. She holds a large purple and black warhammer emitting green and purple energy effects.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long bright pink hair in a high ponytail and goggles on her head, wearing a cropped pink jacket, black crop top, pink shorts, black thigh-high stockings and heavy black boots with neon laces. She is dynamically posed holding a massive purple spiked warhammer that glows with green and purple lightning energy. Two different full-body action poses side by side on a neutral gray background, comic book style with bold black outlines and vibrant colors.
